Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report September 21, 2020 from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Quotations Number Doc 2232696508 Description: Corporate Real Estate Management, Facilities Sourcing, and Purchasing and Materials Management Division (PMMD) recommend the award of an Agreement to CIMCO Refrigeration, a Division of Toromont Industries (CIMCO), for the provision of the services for the upkeep of the Ammonia Refrigeration Equipment used in the operation of City-operated ice-skating rinks. The Agreement covers preventative maintenance and on-demand repair work. The base contract term is three (3) years, with the option to renew for two (2) additional one (1) year periods.
